question:
**Fill in the blank with the most appropriate word.**

Those who complete the test successfully will be moved into a/an _______ class.
solution:
The correct answer is: **advanced**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given words.
 
 
• **Advanced **means highly developed or complex; leveled up.
 
• **Fast **means able to move or act at great speed.
 
• **Rapid **means happening very quickly or moving with great speed.
 
• **Crash **means a course that teaches you a lot of basic facts in a very short time.
 
 
 
• As per the meaning of the given words "**advanced**" is the most appropriate option.
 
• The implied meaning of the sentence is: "*Successful exam takers will be promoted to the upper level.*"
 
• '**An**' should be used "**advanced**" starts with a **vowel (a)** sound.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**.

**Complete sentence:** *Those who complete the test successfully will be moved into an **advanced __**class. *
